segments.name: Therapeutics
segments.description: Develops allogeneic CAR T-cell immunotherapy and gene therapy product candidates for immuno-oncology and monogenic diseases; no products approved for sale.
segments.evidence: As from June 1, 2023 and the deconsolidation of Calyxt, we view our operations and manage our business in a single operating and reportable segment corresponding to the Therapeutics segment.

revenueModel.text: Cellectis derives revenues from collaboration and license agreements, mainly the AstraZeneca Joint Research and Collaboration Agreement and other gene-editing technology licenses, plus milestone payments and royalties from partners such as Servier and Allogene.
revenueModel.evidence: For the twelve-month period ended December 31, 2025, we mainly derived our Therapeutics revenues from the JRCA with AstraZeneca, and from other license agreements for the use of our gene editing technology.

changes.text: In 2023, Calyxt was deconsolidated and the former Plants segment was presented as discontinued operations, leaving a single Therapeutics segment.
changes.evidence: Our former Plants segment is presented as discontinued operations for the year-end period ended December 31, 2023.
